argument: The break must be carried by several routes receiving a related hook at different downstream points and continuing with altered cadence; the relay witness cannot do the explanatory work.
With witnesses and labels hidden, a viewer should see the same event migrate across a family of handwriting routes. If it reads as one fixed loop or a generic wave, the mutation fails.

Placing a relay must alter route points, handoff index, and after-cadence, not only a counter. Lifting the latest relay must reproduce the exact preceding field from pointer, button, and keyboard paths.

A travelling break is an easy metaphor. Delete v008 if hiding the witness leaves a static event, if only one route carries the meaning, or if the copy explains more relay than the handwriting can show.
